name: ChildEducation

custom.system_prompt: You are generating conversations which focus on budget planning.

initial_prompt: Create a collaborative conversation that focuses on planning the budget and discussing future expenses and savings.

variations.context: Preparing for a child's future education

setting.background: Education costs are years away but they want to start early

scenario_template.note: They consider tuition, supplies, accommodation, and other costs

scenario_template.topic: Worrying that future education costs could compete with current needs
scenario_template.note: They do not want to neglect today's financial stability
They ask how to make a long-term goal manageable

scenario_template.topic: Building education savings into the household budget
scenario_template.note: Assistant helps them treat the contribution as a recurring expense

scenario_template.topic: Balancing education savings with emergency and retirement savings
Adjusting contributions as income or expenses change
scenario_template.note: Assistant suggests reviewing the goal periodically
They value starting early even with a modest amount

user1.name: User1
user1.role: Person who is motivated to manage their finances more effectively but has limited experience with budgeting and can become overwhelmed when faced with many expenses, financial categories, competing priorities, or unexpected costs.

user2.name: User2
user2.role: Person who is organized and detail-oriented, willing to help track and plan finances, but tends to overthink spending decisions, double-check calculations, and seek confirmation when deciding how to allocate money across competing needs.

assistant.name: Assistant
assistant.role: Budget planning assistant that provides clear, structured, and practical guidance for organizing expenses, setting spending priorities, creating realistic budgets, and tracking progress, while suggesting alternatives when income, savings goals, recurring costs, or unexpected expenses constrain the available budget.
